Who we are

CreateFuture is fast becoming the UK’s most recognisable digital consultancy, with years of experience building digital products and services for major organisations whilst putting our people first. We have offices in the centre of Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, and London as well as remote employees located throughout the country. 

We are a team of creators - whether that’s code, project plans, go to market strategies, culture initiatives, marketing campaigns, large language models or people policies. And together, with our clients, we create the future. This has seen us collaborate and partner across a multitude of industries and sectors, with the likes of PayPal, Adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert to name just a few.

Our reputation as a partner determined to deliver high-quality, robust and thoughtful products has enabled us to scale to over 500 people in the last couple of years, and it is our amazing people - along with the safe, supportive and friendly culture we have built - that makes CreateFuture a great place to work. Don’t just take our word for it though, we have been recognised by Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row - across a number of categories - and our employee exit rate is astonishingly low. 

Join us on our journey… Let’s create something awesome, together, today.

 

About the role and team:

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You will be embedded in a team delivering for a client in a fast-paced, product-led environment, and you will be accountable for how your workstream is delivered, not just the code you write. You lead from the front: still close enough to the technology to make the call, and senior enough to own the outcome. You set the technical direction, keep the delivery signal honest, and grow the engineers around you. We work at pace. Priorities move, requirements are rarely perfect on day one, and we value people who can bring order to ambiguity rather than wait for it to clear.

How we work with AI:

AI-assisted development is core to how we build, not a side experiment. We use modern AI coding agents to remove the drudgery so engineers can focus on the high-value decisions: architecture, trade-offs, and getting the right thing built. Humans own every change, and quality is held by review and ownership, not by the tool. As a Tech Lead you will help raise the quality and consistency of how the team uses AI: knowing the domain and the codebase well enough to steer the tools, avoid reinventing what already exists, and articulate intent clearly so the AI accelerates good engineering rather than multiplying mediocre code.

Our tech stack Core:

  Java (with Spring Boot) A roughly even split of RESTful Java APIs and Kafka / event-driven services CI/CD pipelines AWS (including S3, Lambda, ECS, EKS, MSK) Broader ecosystem you will get your hands on: Kubernetes and containerisation Infrastructure as code AI integrations and agentic development workflows Strong security practices across the stack Full DevOps ownership ("you build it, you run it")

You will not need all of this from day one, but these are the tools, systems and practices you will work with.

What you'll be doing:

Technical: Building Java services across REST APIs and Kafka / event-driven pipelines (roughly an even split), with a focus on readable, maintainable and well-tested code Writing tests as part of development (TDD approaches are encouraged) Integrating with third-party APIs (for example payment gateways and suppliers) Defining and overseeing technical implementations: shaping how things are built, not just writing code Championing AI-assisted ways of working and lifting the bar on quality, consistency and reuse across the team

Leading the workstream: Owning your workstream end to end: you can always answer what you own and who covers it when you are out, whether you are on track for the next milestone, what is blocked or at risk, and what decision is needed and who needs to know Driving the dates: actively managing delivery rather than passively reporting it, and spotting risk early enough to act before dates slip Getting ahead of the next thing: shaping and estimating upcoming work with product and delivery before it hits the team, so the team drives the work rather than inheriting it Communicating before you are chased, and working in the open (visible progress in shared channels, feedback captured where it belongs) Identifying and removing bottlenecks in delivery Handling difficult client conversations professionally when needed, with support from your colleagues Spotting knowledge gaps and offering mentoring, pairing and coaching to grow the engineers around you

 

We'd love to talk to you if:

  • You have strong Java and Spring Boot, across both REST APIs and event-driven / Kafka systems
  • You care about engineering quality: code reviews, automated tests, and maintainability
  • You lead in the open, share knowledge, and actively raise the bar for the team
  • You are comfortable driving delivery and, with support, handling client conversations
  • You embrace AI-assisted development: using modern AI tools to go faster while owning the quality and knowing when to trust them and when not to
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can bring structure to ambiguity
  • You are familiar with cloud services and CI/CD, or excited to learn more
  • You want to build more than boilerplate APIs: solving real problems, with proper ownership

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement en interne, nous recrutons un·e Lead Data Engineer, basé·e à Lille.

Nous souhaitons accélérer la transformation et la digitalisation de nos processus RH, en partie grâce à une forte maîtrise de nos données People et de leurs usages. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous déployons une plateforme RH mondiale (Workday) qui intégrera un CORE RH et plusieurs modules de talent management pour les 65 pays dans lesquels Decathlon est implanté.

Votre mission : Au croisement de la stratégie et de l'exécution technique, vous serez le/la garant·e technique de la migration de nos données depuis nos systèmes legacy vers Workday. En tant que Lead Data Engineer, vous concevrez l'architecture de transformation, piloterez la création des pipelines de données, et mettrez en place un monitoring rigoureux pour assurer une migration "zéro défaut". Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du Program Leader et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes projet locales et globales.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

1. Architecture et Stratégie de Transformation des données :

  • Définir l'architecture technique et la stratégie de migration des données de nos systèmes sources (legacies) vers le template cible Workday.

  • Identifier le périmètre technique de la migration et concevoir des modèles de données répondant aux exigences fonctionnelles et de sécurité.

  • Documenter de manière précise les systèmes sources, les flux, et les règles de transformation complexes.

2. Ingénierie et Développement (Hands-on & Leadership) :

  • Concevoir, développer et superviser des pipelines de données robustes, évolutifs et sécurisés (ETL) pour extraire, transformer et charger les données locales vers la plateforme mondiale.

  • Définir et implémenter les règles de transformation avancées pour adapter nos données historiques aux standards stricts de l'intégrateur Workday.

  • Assurer l'intégrité, le chiffrage et la sécurité des données RH (données sensibles) tout au long du processus.

3. Monitoring des erreurs, Tests et Qualité des données :

  • Mettre en place les outils de monitoring des pipelines et de gestion des erreurs (alerting, logs) pour identifier, isoler et corriger les anomalies en temps réel lors des phases de tests et de "Go-Live".

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de contrôle qualité automatisés (Data Quality) pour garantir la conformité absolue des données migrées.

  • Coordonner les tests de migration (unitaires, intégration, fonctionnels) et organiser les activités de validation post-migration.

4. Leadership Technique et Coordination :

  • Piloter techniquement les ressources data impliquées dans la migration, animer les rituels techniques et garantir les délais et la qualité des livrables.

  • Maintenir une communication claire avec les parties prenantes (Data Stream Leader, équipes métiers, intégrateur externe), vulgariser les enjeux techniques et remonter les alertes avec des plans de mitigation.

  • Bases de données : Maîtrise des bases de données relationnelles (PostgreSQL) et compréhension des bases NoSQL.

  • Développement & Qualité : Maîtrise des langages de programmation data, des pratiques CI/CD (GIT, Jenkins), de la conteneurisation et des tests logiciels.

37b9d0c35372.location: Lille - Jardin des Plantes, Nord; Paris, Paris
37b9d0c35372.description:
Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e AI engineer, basé-e au choix à Lille ou Paris.

 

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe Finance Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer les métiers de la finance par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation des analyses exécutées par la fonction FP&A, notre ambition est de construire des solutions plus standardisées avec l’appui de l’IA. Il s'agit d’implémenter des couches d'intelligence centralisées et agnostiques des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, EPM, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons des débriefs de performance financière générés par l’IA pour toutes les activités de l’entreprise. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable et sur laquelle ils peuvent prendre des décisions.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, Espagne, Italie et Belgique, ce projet est le premier d’une série à venir.

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "Builder" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

 

 🎯 VOTRE MISSION

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de nos solutions d’IA pour les contrôleurs de gestion. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié, en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers et un Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.

 

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

  1. Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités
  • Participer à l'extension des capacités de nos agents vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant notamment des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).
  • Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.
  1. Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)
  • Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité de nos pipelines (Databricks / Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).
  • Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.
  • Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow, Langfuse).
  • Coder des évaluateurs automatiques pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.
  • Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.
  1. Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International
  • Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.
  • Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de nos solutions en adaptant les pipelines, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues.
  1. Produit & Impact Business
  • Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de nos produits
  • Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès.

 

🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE

Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience. 

  • Expérience : Profil confirmé justifiant de plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orienté IA. Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.
  • Stack Technique : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI + Databricks, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou Google ADK).
  • Expertise LLM & Agentique : Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.
  • Qualité & Évaluation : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de retrieval ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / MLflow).
  • Langues : Français courant obligatoire & anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).

Les plus : 

  • Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.
  • Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.

74ca2c8a8e99.title: AI Engineer H/F - Paris
74ca2c8a8e99.description: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital , créée en 2007. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation. Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables. Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées. Quelques exemples de projets AI Engineer Conception et développement d’agents autonomes pour automatiser des processus métiers : conception de workflows complexes, notamment dans l’industrie ou la relation client, dans lesquels des agents IA enchaînent des tâches, prennent des décisions et interagissent avec les outils et les données internes de l’entreprise. Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle. Déploiement de plateformes Cloud : conception et déploiement d’environnements permettant de développer, sécuriser, superviser et faire évoluer des solutions IA. Évaluation, observabilité et gouvernance des solutions IA : mise en place de dispositifs permettant de suivre la qualité, les coûts, les performances et la sécurité des applications IA, afin d’en garantir la fiabilité et la pérennité. AI Engineer – Data & IA (H/F) Votre profil Nous recherchons un profil de formation supérieure (Bac+5) en informatique, ingénierie logicielle, data ou domaine équivalent. Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en développement Data & IA, en data engineering, machine learning engineering ou conception de solutions IA. Vous disposez de solides bases en Python et en développement logiciel : APIs, Git, tests, conteneurisation et CI/CD. Vous avez déjà participé à des projets d’industrialisation de solutions IA, idéalement autour du RAG, des agents IA, des environnements Cloud et de la mise en production. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pragmatique et curieuse, capable de comprendre un besoin métier pour le traduire en solution technique concrète. Une bonne maîtrise du français et un niveau d’anglais technique sont attendus. Votre rôle en tant qu’AI Engineer Chez AVISIA, vous interviendrez sur des problématiques techniques variées, de la conception jusqu’au déploiement de solutions IA en production. Selon votre expérience, vos compétences et les projets, vous pourrez notamment intervenir sur : L’analyse des besoins et la conception d’architectures IA adaptées aux enjeux métiers. Le développement d’agents IA, de workflows et d’applications RAG . L’intégration d’outils, d’APIs et de données d’entreprise. Le développement d’APIs, de serveurs MCP et de services backend. L’industrialisation et le déploiement de solutions dans des environnements Cloud. La mise en place de tests, d’évaluations, de dispositifs d’observabilité et de sécurité. La documentation des solutions et le partage des bonnes pratiques avec les équipes. Vous travaillerez en proximité avec les clients et les consultants AVISIA pour contribuer aux choix techniques, proposer des solutions pertinentes et faire progresser les expertises autour de l’IA générative. Les environnements techniques Pas besoin de maîtriser l’ensemble de ces technologies pour nous rejoindre ! Nous recherchons avant tout des profils solides en développement, curieux et motivés, avec l’envie d’apprendre et de monter en compétences sur les sujets d’IA générative, d’industrialisation et de Cloud. Selon vos compétences, vos envies et les projets sur lesquels vous interviendrez, vous pourrez être amené(e) à travailler avec différentes technologies : Langages & frameworks : Python, SQL, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, ADK, LlamaIndex, APIs d’IA générative (OpenAI, Anthropic…). DevOps & industrialisation : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git. Plateformes Data & Cloud : Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku. L’objectif : vous permettre de développer progressivement votre expertise, de découvrir de nouvelles technologies et de construire un parcours professionnel qui vous ressemble. Ce que nous vous offrons Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien. Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso , grâce à notre politique de télétravail. Une mutuelle familiale pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. Une formation continue via l’AVISIA School, pour développer vos compétences et rester à la pointe des technologies Data & IA. Des certifications pour valoriser votre expertise et accompagner votre montée en compétences. De réelles perspectives d’évolution : Contributeur, Senior, Tech Lead, Business Leader, Practice Leader… Plusieurs parcours sont possibles selon vos envies et vos ambitions. Un accompagnement de proximité , avec des échanges réguliers pour suivre vos projets et construire la suite de vo

Nos missions allient une dimension technique et opérationnelle permettant d’approfondir vos connaissances sur des sujets novateurs. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée afin de développer et faire vivre les applications data stratégiques de nos clients. Lors de vos projets vous serez amené à travailler sur les éléments suivants : Vous participerez au cadrage du besoin client et à la réflexion sur les méthodologies et architectures à mettre en œuvre pour y apporter des réponses grâce à la Data et à l'IA, Vous identifierez, intégrerez et structurerez les données (sources, connecteurs ETL/ELT, modélisation) pour transformer la donnée brute en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) exploitables et fiables, Vous réaliserez des analyses approfondies et concevrez des modèles (statistiques, machine learning, algorithmes IA, agentiques) pour répondre à des problématiques complexes (comportement client, prédictif, optimisation), Vous mettrez en valeur vos résultats et industrialiserez vos solutions , en créant des outils de restitution pour les équipes métiers et en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de programmation, Vous ferez preuve d'une forte appétence pour l'écosystème IA , en restant en veille sur les innovations, en expérimentant de nouveaux usages et en développant des briques/solutions IA dès que le sujet s'y prête. En fonction de votre appétence et de vos envies, un sujet à dominante technique ou business vous sera confié. Ci-dessous des exemples de sujet : Optimisation de la préparation de commande en magasin avec un algorithme d’optimisation sous contrainte, Utilisation de la Gen AI pour extraire des informations depuis des documents PDF et générer des synonymes afin d’améliorer les recherches documentaires, Mise en place d’un score de churn par rayon et par magasin avec utilisation de méthodes de Machine Learning Interprétable, Implémentation d’une segmentation des visites basées sur les données de navigation du site e-commerce , Identifier les magasins à caractère saisonnier en termes de chiffre d’affaires, afin d’ajuster les budgets hebdomadaires et d'optimiser le ciblage des campagnes marketing, Développement d’un dashboard dédié au service du Contrôle de Gestion d’un grand groupe de prêt-à-porter afin d’analyser tous les mois le profil des clients ayant contribué au chiffre d’affaires, Développement d'agents conversationnels (LLM) pour interroger les données de vente et mise en place de cas d'usage IA. Lab’ AVISIA : En complément de nos missions, nous menons divers projets internes qui alimentent notre recherche et développement . Ces projets nous donnent l'opportunité d'offrir à nos clients des approches analytiques innovantes, testées en grandeur nature. Afin de soutenir ces initiatives, nous avons mis en place nos propres infrastructures . Nos consultants bénéficient ainsi des ressources les plus récentes et des dernières solutions du marché pour leur apprentissage, y compris des versions "early adopter" à tester avant leur mise à disposition générale. Nos engagements : Après avoir mis en place une politique interne solide en termes de RSE, nous avons souhaité mettre nos compétences au service de projets orientés développement durable . Une initiative dédiée est née : AVISIA Impact . Cette initiative est ainsi notre réponse pour apporter une contribution directe (via nos projets) et indirecte (via la formation de nos équipes) aux enjeux de transformation durable. Nous voulons ainsi faciliter l’émergence des futurs acteurs de la transformation et accélérer le rythme du changement. Pour plus d'information sur ces initiatives data au service de la transformation durable, n'hésitez pas à consulter notre page dédiée Data For Impact . Les compétences : Vous êtes en dernière année de formation data à l’université ou en grande école et disposez des compétences suivantes : Très bonne connaissance du SQL et Python, Bonne connaissance des principaux algorithmes de machine learning, Capacité à expliquer des concepts complexes de façon simple et pédagogique, Bonne connaissance des outils d'IA générative (Gemini, chatGPT…) et de développement assisté (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code...) pour optimiser son efficacité au quotidien, Petit plus : Vous avez des notions sur les technologies cloud (Ex : Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Snowflake...) et/ou d’une solution logicielle du marché de traitement et d’analyse de la donnée (Ex : Dataiku, Databricks…) Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

b7955c10fb3e.title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
b7955c10fb3e.description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. About the role Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API. ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure. Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become. What you need to succeed Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more. Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks. 11a056305b73.title: Lead Analytics Engineer
11a056305b73.description: Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals. Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed. Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. Role and Responsibilities AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools. Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business. This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. 471abbc3cb7f.title: Data Engineer
471abbc3cb7f.description: De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering. Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt. Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken. Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk. Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn. Nog geen doorgewinterde expert? Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact. Persoonlijke vaardigheden: Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes Professionele vaardigheden: HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines Pré: Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering Waarom werken bij PuurData? Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werkweek in te richten en werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij uiteenlopende klanten, geen saaie repeterende klussen. Je werkt in een platte organisatie waar jouw mening telt en er snel geschakeld wordt. Daarnaast bieden we een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage en volop ruimte om door te groeien. Herken jij jezelf hierin? We horen graag van je. Samenwerking: door middel van initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn sessies leren wij van en met elkaar en dankzij onze Pitch Discovery Sessions is er altijd ruimte om te werken aan je eigen projecten en met nieuwe technieken. Wat zien wij graag in onze toekomstige collega? Je hebt een professionele en gestructureerde werkhouding, bent ambitieus en durft uitdagingen aan te gaan, denkt creatief mee met klanten over innovatieve oplossingen en neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor je planning. Verder vinden wij het volgende belangrijk: Je hebt een robuuste en uitgebreide achtergrond in C++ programmeren. Bekendheid met Agentic of AI ondersteund programmeren. Bekendheid met Qt en Python is een pré (maar niet vereist). Kennis van elektronica is een pré (maar niet essentieel). Een afgeronde BSc. of MSc. opleiding op het gebied van Informatica of aanverwant. Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal op alle vlakken. Over Benchmark Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s). Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd. 4c0222b540d3.title: Medior C++ Software Engineer
4c0222b540d3.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As a Medior C++ Engineer, you will take ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You will design, implement, and improve robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems, and real-time environments. You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to ensure system reliability, maintainability, and performance. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know Vitestro's software architecture, hardware-integrated systems, and development processes. You build an understanding of how our software interacts with different subsystems and start contributing to the design, implementation, and improvement of software components in modern C++ (C++17/20). Working closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers, you become familiar with our state-machine-based logic, DDS communication protocols, and Linux and real-time environments. You contribute to debugging, automated testing, and code reviews while building the knowledge needed to take ownership of software components. After your first month you will be able to contribute to the velocity of the team by working on new features in the scope of the motion team. You will be able to solve complex integration issues coming from production and the field. This is what success looks like After 12 months, you have taken ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You confidently design, implement, and maintain robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems and real-time environments. You actively contribute to improving the existing software architecture, ensuring maintainability, scalability, and performance. You design and maintain structured state-machine-based logic, integrate evolving hardware components into the software stack, and contribute to system-level design discussions and technical decisions. You work effectively with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to debug complex issues across software and hardware boundaries. You have contributed to improving testability and automated verification strategies, actively participate in code reviews, and help raise software quality standards. After your first year, you will own significant nontrivial features and parts of the code-base of the team. You will be a key knowledge holder of the implementation of the motion software unit as well as accuracy calibrations and verifications. You actively engage in building the roadmap for the coming years together with other engineers. What You'll Bring: Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. 4–7 years of experience developing C++ software in a professional environment. Proven experience designing and maintaining production-level software systems. Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20). Experience structuring code for maintainability and scalability. Experience with automated testing. Experience working in Linux environments. Strong debugging skills in complex systems. Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows. Nice to Have: Experience designing and implementing state machines. Experience with hardware–software integration. Familiarity with DDS or similar pub/sub communication frameworks. Experience working in real-time or near real-time systems. Python scripting experience. Exposure to robotics or industrial communication protocols (EtherCAT, CANopen). What we offer: Competitive salary including pension plan 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position Hybrid work model Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away Annual training budget of €2000,- Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics We offer an environment where you can make a lot of impact, as you are joining a growing scale-up in MedTech. Our team of driven and talented colleagues enjoys solving the challenges in developing, manufacturing, and completing our breakthrough medical device. While working in an open culture, we strive for excellence in all domains. We believe in taking courage and like to challenge each other. We learn and teach, regardless of age, nationality or gender. 6ded95cacaae.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Regional Research Economist at Anthropic, you will collaborate with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region to measure and understand AI’s effects on the economy and explore research-driven policy interventions. You will contribute to the development of the Anthropic Economic Index and its extension to generate regionally relevant insights, establish new methodologies to measure the usage, diffusion, and impact of AI throughout the economy, and work to broaden access to and usage of the insights generated by the Index. You will use frontier methods in econometrics, machine learning, and structural estimation. Such rigor will drive impact, shaping both policy discussions externally and informing Anthropic’s internal business and product decisions. Our team combines rigorous empirical methods with novel measurement approaches. We’re building first-of-its-kind datasets tracking AI’s impact on labor markets, productivity, and economic transformation. Using our privacy-preserving measurement system ( Clio ), we analyze millions of real-world AI interactions to understand how AI augments and automates work across different occupations and tasks. For this role, we’re looking for candidates who can combine rigorous economic analysis with novel measurement approaches to understand AI’s transformative effects on the economy. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at the intersection of empirical economics, technological change, and policy impact. f03773d68e3d.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Runtime
f03773d68e3d.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
f03773d68e3d.description: P-1096 At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone. That's why we built AI Runtime , a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters. It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable , make training fault-tolerant , and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x . As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving the hardest technical problems and shaping where AI Runtime goes next. The impact you will have: Drive AI Runtime's architecture and lead Databricks' long-term technical direction in AI training infrastructure. Define the reliability and observability strategy for a fleet that keeps growing in scale and complexity. Shape AI Runtime's developer experience for people and agents, so even the largest training jobs feel as simple as a first experiment. Anticipate industry trends and choose the technical bets that prepare AI Runtime for new GPU generations and workload types. Take on the hardest multi-node training problems yourself, from orchestration and GPU scheduling to data loading and checkpointing. Make training faster and cheaper by raising efficiency across model architectures and GPU accelerators. Work with research, product, and customers to decide what we build next and align teams on hard technical calls. Champion engineering excellence, raise the bar, and help us hire and grow great engineers. What we look for: 15+ years in large-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in GPU training, high-performance computing, or ML systems. Hands-on experience training large models with FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron, and fluency in parallelism strategies. Expertise in GPU performance, including accelerator architecture, high-speed interconnects, and kernels. Strong understanding of training resilience patterns, such as checkpointing, failure detection, and automatic recovery. A background in building and running multi-tenant cloud platforms as products. A track record of setting technical direction across teams and seeing it through to business impact. The credibility to bring teams to agreement on difficult trade-offs, and a reputation as a mentor senior engineers seek out. BS in Computer Science or a related field (MS or PhD preferred). cafe0d9150eb.description: Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human eval and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition. At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI. At the foundation of these products is the Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will support the design and development of shared platforms used across Scale. This includes designing our foundational data platforms and lifecycle, architecting Scale’s core cloud infrastructure and orchestration stack, and redefining how engineers develop, build, test, and deploy software at Scale. You’ll also get widespread exposure to the forefront of the AI race as Scale sees it in enterprises, startups, governments, and large tech companies. You will: Drive the design, and implementation of our foundational platforms and systems, working closely with stakeholders and internal customers to understand and refine requirements. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features. Proactively identifying opportunities for, and driving improvements to, current programming practices, including process enhancements and tool upgrades. Presenting technical information to teams and stakeholders, providing guidance and insight on development processes and technologies. Ideally you’d have: 3+ years of full-time engineering experience, post-graduation with specialities in back-end systems. Extensive experience in software development and a deep understanding of distributed systems and public cloud platforms (AWS preferred). Show a track record of independent ownership of successful engineering projects. Possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Experience working fluently with standard containerization & deployment technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, etc. Experience with orchestration platforms, such as Temporal and AWS Step Functions. Experience with NoSQL document databases (MongoDB) and structured databases (Postgres). Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices and CI/CD tooling (CircleCI). Nice to haves: Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Firebolt) and data pipeline/ETL tools (Dagster, dbt). Experience with authentication/authorization systems (Zanzibar, Authz, etc.) Experience scaling products at hyper-growth startups. Excitement to work with AI technologies. 21b17fa441c0.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
21b17fa441c0.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. Your role Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us. To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career. Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum requirements A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience). Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present. Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting). Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes. Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. 5761a915e86d.title: Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
5761a915e86d.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Austin, US About the Role Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission. Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network. The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base. CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core. Rapid response. When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation. Proactive engineering. When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds. Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline. Responsibilities Rapid response: Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream. Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering. Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time. Proactive engineering: Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end. Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle. Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate. Rapid incident response and root cause analysis. Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolut

f1d75d93202e.title: Research Communications, Models & Frontier AI
f1d75d93202e.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Product & Research Communications team helps people understand our technology, what it makes possible, and how to use it. We work closely with teams across the company to bring new products and research to the world, tell stories grounded in real experiences, and build trusted relationships with journalists.



About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on communications leader to own the launch strategy and storytelling for OpenAI’s frontier AI models across ChatGPT and the API. You’ll turn advances in model capabilities into clear, compelling stories for research, developer, customer, and consumer audiences.

You’ll get into the details with researchers, engineers, and product teams to understand what has changed, what the evidence shows, and what people can do with it. That means working through evaluations, exploring model behavior, and finding concrete examples that make an advance clear without losing its limitations.

This role calls for technical curiosity and strong editorial judgment. You should be as comfortable working through an evaluation with a researcher as writing a launch blog, shaping a media strategy, or preparing a leader for an interview.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Lead model launches end to end across ChatGPT and the API, owning positioning, messaging, media strategy, spokesperson preparation, rollout, and follow-through.

 - Work with researchers, engineers, and product teams from the earliest stages of a release. Dig into capability changes, evaluations, model behavior, and limitations to identify what is new and why it matters.

 - Develop distinct stories for research, developer, customer, and consumer audiences, explaining the technical advance, what developers can build, how customers can apply it, and what it makes possible in everyday life.

 - Partner closely with the head of B2B communications to translate frontier AI advances, including changes in model cost and efficiency, into clear, evidence-backed stories about customer use cases and business value.

 - Find and develop compelling demonstrations, use cases, and proof points with research and product teams. Test claims against the evidence and make clear where a result does and does not generalize.

 - Write and edit launch blogs, messaging, FAQs, pitches, and briefings, staying close to the work from the first technical discussion through final materials.

 - Build trusted relationships with journalists across technology, science, business, and consumer media. Prepare researchers and leaders for substantive briefings, interviews, and public engagements.

 - Lead communications and editorial work on model system cards with safety researchers and safety communications colleagues, keeping evaluations, safeguards, and limitations clear and consistent with the launch.

 - Bring together consumer, developer, B2B, safety, and regional communications partners, alongside Marketing and Legal, to align stories, reviews, timing, and responsibilities.

 - Build a sustained story about model progress between launches. Use audience questions, media coverage, and real-world feedback to identify follow-up stories and sharpen future communications.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong track record leading major launches for technically complex products or research, with clear ownership of both strategy and execution.

 - Enjoy getting into the details with researchers and engineers. You can work through evaluations, ask precise questions, and identify the story in a capability change.

 - Are an excellent writer and editor who can make the same technical advance meaningful to researchers, developers, business customers, and everyday users.

 - Know how to build a story from evidence, demonstrations, and real use cases, and can distinguish a meaningful advance from a result that needs more context.

 - Bring strong media judgment and trusted relationships with journalists, and can prepare technical and executive spokespeople for demanding questions.

 - Can lead a complex launch across teams, make sound calls as plans change, and take responsibility for the details as well as the big picture.

 - Have sound judgment about public claims, sensitive information, and timing. You know when to challenge an assumption, seek expert review, or explain uncertainty.

 - Build strong partnerships across functions, give clear editorial feedback, and bring genuine curiosity about AI and how people use it.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

The ChatGPT Learning team creates the next generation of learning experiences within ChatGPT. Millions of people use ChatGPT each week to explore concepts, practice skills, and work through challenges, making learning one of the platform’s largest consumer use cases.

We want ChatGPT to support sustained learning and progress over time, beyond answering individual questions. We’re exploring how AI can make powerful learning tools more accessible, helping people understand the world, develop skills, and pursue their goals.

Our work brings together product engineering, design, AI research, and education to serve learners around the world.

We’re looking for an engineer with strong product judgment who can turn ambiguous opportunities into clear direction, lead complex initiatives from concept through launch, and raise the quality of the team’s technical work.
