2a534f4a3373.title: Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
2a534f4a3373.description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.
  • Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.
  • Data Pipelines & Integration: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.
  • Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.
  • Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.
  • Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

You will thrive in this role if

  • Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills: You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.
  • Experience with dbt: You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.
  • Data Engineering & Python: You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.
  • Data Warehousing Knowledge: You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
  • Data Quality & Reliability: You

75b6c880144a.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
75b6c880144a.description:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Kabelsketal bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 3 Teamleitenden und über 30 Lagermitarbeitenden.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.
Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

0246c858931d.description:
Team description

You've probably paid for a coffee or tapped your card at a hairdresser using one of our card readers already. Our Hardware team designs and builds the beautifully engineered payment devices and accessories that let millions of small merchants start, run and grow their businesses, spanning industrial design, electronics, embedded systems, mobile apps and backend services. As Senior Hardware Engineer, you'll shape the electrical architecture behind our next generation of products, including new designs built on modern Android platforms, giving you real influence over how SumUp's hardware portfolio takes shape from the very first schematic.

What you'll do

  • Design and review electrical schematics, defining hardware architectures for new products

  • Partner with Mechanical Engineering, Android and embedded software, Product and Supply Chain teams to align platform choices, interfaces and product integration

  • Own hardware delivery from prototyping and bring up through validation and mass production readiness, debugging designs and reducing technical risk along the way

  • Explore new design approaches and prototype untested concepts to work through tough technical challenges

  • Lead technical workstreams and design reviews, coordinate implementation across cross functional teams, and mentor colleagues to share hardware engineering knowledge

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Significant experience in electrical engineering, gained in consumer electronics or hardware product development.

  • Strong knowledge across several of the following areas: RF (cellular, NFC, Wi-Fi/BT), power design, digital buses and protocols, battery technology or analogue design.

  • Track record of bringing multiple hardware products through to mass production.

  • Proficiency in a mainstream CAD system such as Altium or Cadence/Allegro.

  • Ability to create hardware architectures for modern Android based products and work closely with Android or embedded software teams on platform integration.

Nice to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, with a Master's a bonus.

  • Basic coding skills for simple firmware validation, with Android device bring up experience a plus.

We know candidates often feel they need to tick every box before applying. That's just a guide. If some of the above sounds like room to grow rather than something you already do, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🎁 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. ced6c9972da5.title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/x)
ced6c9972da5.description:
Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.

Location: Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.

 

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

 

The platform you build in

Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.

 

Your responsibilities

  • You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve
  • You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves
  • You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity
  • You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix
  • You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code
  • You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them
  • Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others
  • Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology
  • Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work
  • English at C1 level, written and spoken. German is not required — we work in English

Nice to have

  • Snowflake and dbt — you can pick both up here
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or reviewing their work
  • Comfort operating where the answer is not defined yet

What to expect from us

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days remote – plus 25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
  • 28 days annual leave
  • 2× annual career & development conversations
  • Company pension with 20% employer contribution
  • Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)
  • FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy
  • Virtual stock options — share in the upside
  • Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work
  • Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events
  • Lived diversity: active women's network, meditation & prayer room

 

Apply now — your CV is enough.

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As an Inside Solutions Engineer, you will collaborate with sales representatives and partners to showcase the value of BeyondTrust’s products, services, and solutions. Acting as a technical specialist within the sales cycle, you will provide foundational support to highlight the capabilities of the BeyondTrust suite. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop their technical expertise and customer-facing skills in a supportive, team-oriented environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with marketing campaigns, including webinars and product demonstrations.
  • Support lead qualification by validating technical environments and understanding business problems.
  • Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.
  • Participate in discovery and opportunity engagement by conducting background research, qualifying questions, and understanding customer needs.
  • Articulate the business value of BeyondTrust solutions to prospects and customers.
  • Demonstrate how BeyondTrust solutions address customer challenges and deliver on the value proposition.
  • Assist in developing written proposals to complement financial proposals for prospects.
  • Play a key role in securing the technical win for opportunities by effectively presenting solutions and value.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience, including help desk and/or technical support of applications, server infrastructure, desktops, virtualization, and directories.
  • Good understanding of common operating systems and network topologies.
  • Familiarity with foundational security concepts and practices.
  • Ability to assess technical requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to thrive in a team-selling environment.
  • Comfortable delivering presentations to audiences of varying sizes.
  • Security+, Network+, or equivalent industry certifications.

Nice To Have

  • Pre-sales experience is advantageous but not required.
  • Basic working knowledge of Linux and Azure Active Directory.
  • Familiarity with BeyondTrust products (Privilege Management for Desktops, Remote Support, Privileged Remote Access).
  • Security-focused qualifications or certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with security solutions such as anti-malware, data protection, firewalls, and mobile/email/web security.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces. Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases. Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers. Nice but not required Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization. FastAPI and Pydantic experience. DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. 5be734f561fa.title: Senior Backend Engineer
5be734f561fa.description: About Peec AI Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win. We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend. This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about. The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do. We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings. What we’re looking for 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment. Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code. Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling. Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data. Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state. Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications. High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness. A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model. Tech stack Languages: TypeScript, Python Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services Cloud/infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging Product/data domain: LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics AI/model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them What we offer Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups Regular team events and off-sites Aggressive equity compensation package Paid Dinner & Uber home when working late The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin Compensation: €100K – €150K • Offers Equity • €100K – €150K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Das bieten wir Echte Verantwortung für den Bereich Befähigung, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Konzernpolitik Geile Kunden - Logos die du alle kennst Remote-Arbeit mit flexibler Zeiteinteilung Schnelle Lernkurve an hochaktuellen KI-Themen Senioriges Fix-Gehalt plus, wenn du Ownership möchtest, zusätzlich ein Provisionsmodell im Bereich Customer Success Management Ein Team, in dem Leistung gesehen und belohnt wird Bewerben dauert nur wenige Minuten. Danach lernen wir uns persönlich kennen und schauen, ob wir zusammenpassen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

c9a084e21aea.description: About Tensordyne AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! About the role Tensordyne builds high-performance, power-efficient inference hardware, backed by our novel AI math approach. You will work within a team working on the inference backend software. Your focus will be on a part of a software stack of a future Tensordyne product. In this role, you will Design and develop distributed cloud services in Rust Maintain Rust software developed in-house, as well as work with external frameworks Build APIs for generative AI Collaborate across different teams to derive design specifications and decisions Orchestrate agent teams to implement features Preferred qualifications Experience with modern Rust Experience with agentic tools and workflows Knowledge of common Rust design patterns, including patterns for asynchronous code General awareness of network technologies and high-level protocols like HTTP General awareness of Kubernetes and other related technologies is a plus Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values Put people first. 07964262c2ad.description: About the team: As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale. The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide. What you'll do: Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health You'll be a great fit for this role if you: Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team Why you should join SumUp: 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which you can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp We believe in the everyday hero. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a 'team-first' attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. d38892aa5052.title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
d38892aa5052.description: We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions. The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it? About Nelly We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people. Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality. What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable. Joining us, you will: Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs What you'll bring: Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product 7+ years of product management experience Even better if you have: Built and shipped AI products Worked on data platforms or data products Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry Professional German language knowledge Our Interview Process: Introduction to Nelly with TA Product craft interview with our Product manager Case study interview with Director of Product Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders What we offer: The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it. Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still. A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact. Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast. Urban Sports Club membership , for sport and balance. Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup. Up to 4 weeks of workation. A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with. We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

96d1c322d304.title: Legal Counsel - IT & Data Protection
96d1c322d304.description: Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Legal Counsel to support our business in IT & Data Protection matters! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique Why can this position be exciting for you? In this role, you will be the core link between regulatory requirements and day-to-day operations. By partnering in early stages with product and engineering teams, you turn complex privacy rules – including emerging AI frameworks – into straightforward, actionable guidance that keeps projects moving forward & safely. From streamlining vendor reviews and data subject requests to mapping risks across our systems, your work lead to practical processes, ensuring AMBOSS expands into new markets with scalable compliance already built in. You will: Be a trusted data protection advisor for our teams. You partner with product and engineering from concept to launch, including on [AI-based features / new markets]. You give clear, pragmatic recommendations. Own data protection risk assessment across our systems and processes. You identify, assess and prioritise compliance risks and turn them into practical frameworks that teams can use. Keep us ahead of international requirements. You track data protection and related regulation in our markets, including AI-related rules, and turn them into pragmatic solutions for AMBOSS. Make vendors, tools and contracts easy to get right. You review and negotiate data processing agreements and assess new software and vendors, so the business gets fast, reliable answers. Build and improve our data protection operations. You own our policies, the record of processing activities and the handling of data subject requests (access, rectification, erasure). You simplify, standardise and automate wherever possible. Work as one team. You collaborate closely with our DPO, the General Counsel and the wider Legal team, and bring in external input when it makes sense. You bring: Legal qualification ( Diploma; 1st state exam, LLM or international equivalent) At least 4 years of experience in IT law and data protection at a law firm or in-house, with a clear track record of giving practical, decision-ready advice to a diverse range of stakeholders Strong working knowledge of GDPR and how to apply it pragmatically in a product environment Prior experience working alongside engineering, product, and technical teams to translate complex legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into actionable product features, technical specifications, and workflows Technical curiosity: you enjoy understanding how systems and data flows work A pragmatic interest in AI and legal technology, and ideally experience using these tools to work faster and more effectively You enjoy: A diverse Legal Portfolio: Drive a fast-evolving mix of IT legal matters, data protection frameworks, and commercial advisory Uncharted legal territory: High-stakes regulatory challenges and emerging tech questions where the playbook hasn't been written yet High autonomy, real impact: Move past "no" to craft actionable, business-enabling solutions with complete ownership of your domain Continuous Improvement: Disrupt outdated legal workflows and refine our operational baseline for scale A humorous and high-performing team :) Benefits: AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony. 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more) 🥙Food & Office Comfort ( Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town) 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…) Check out the full list of benefits below: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. 9b7549a6207e.title: Robotics Engineer - Integration & Control (m/f/d)
9b7549a6207e.description: About Prefiro Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field. Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have? Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms. Your responsibilities Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery. Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time. Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration. Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading. Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data. Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team. Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season. What you bring Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field. At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation). Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3. Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files. Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning. Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar). Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus. Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux. Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading). Fluent English , our working language. Nice to have Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots. Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions. MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning. Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing). DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups. Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems. Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting. Basic German. What we offer Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany. Short way from code to robot. New ideas usually run on the real machine within a few days. A problem worth solving. Green asparagus is still harvested entirely by hand. A small, motivated team that gets a lot done together. When you join, we're 8 full-time, plus 2 interns and a working student. Open culture, flat hierarchies. We are still early, so your opinion counts in technical decisions. Lunch and coffee together in the kitchen in our hall. Employee stock options. How to apply Send your CV and a few lines on a robotics project you built on real hardware (links to code welcome) via the "Apply now" button. The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the event-processing pipelines and services that turn Nebius product usage into revenue.
You will work on systems that process a continuous stream of usage events, where correctness and failure recovery matter as much as throughput. The output is money: a silently dropped or double-counted event is a real financial error.
Usage of every Nebius product arrives as a stream of events. Our pipelines and services ingest, validate, enrich and price it in near real time, and deliver the results to invoicing, reporting and customer-facing account management.

In this role, you will:

  • Build stateful streaming pipelines that compute billed consumption in near real time.
  • Develop and operate Go services that ingest usage events, move data between our storage systems and deliver consumption data to users through usage APIs and billing data exports.
  • Guarantee correctness under failures: idempotency, exactly-once processing and reconciliation.
  • Operate transactional storage, persistent queues and change data capture under high throughput.
  • Build reusable streaming infrastructure rather than solving each use case independently.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, latency and observability of the billing platform.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of your systems: design, implementation, reliability and deployment.

  • Experience with databases, messaging systems or event-processing platforms.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Implementation Engineer als Unterstützung für das Technical Onboarding Team in Berlin. Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere komplexesten Implementierungen des KI-basierten Telefonassistenten und stellst sicher, dass Praxen und Krankenhäuser ein effizientes, zuverlässiges und nachhaltiges Onboarding-Erlebnis haben. Als technischer Sparring Partner im Team entwickelst Du Standards, Prozesse und Lösungen, die unser Onboarding skalierbarer machen – und wirkst mit Deinen Verbesserungen weit über den eigenen Bereich hinaus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst technisch anspruchsvolle Installationen und Konfigurationen des KI-gestützten Telefon Assistenten bei Key Accounts – inklusive komplexer Telefonanlagen und Eskalationsfälle, und sorgst so für eine konsistent gute Onboarding-Journey unserer Kund:innen.
  • Du treibst unsere Multi-Onboarding-Strategie voran und verantwortest mittelfristig auch das Onboarding unseres Kalenders und unserer All-in-One Praxissoftware – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Technical Onboarding Teams.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du bist die primäre technische Ansprechperson für Key Accounts, deren IT sowie für Key Account Manager:innen und pflegst aktiv die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern aus Sales, Deployment und Product.
  • Wissenstransfer & Coaching: Du coachst Kolleg:innen, teilst Dein Know-how proaktiv und definierst Best Practices, Playbooks und Trainingsmaterialien – für ein höheres technisches Niveau und mehr Konsistenz im gesamten Team.
  • Projektmanagement: Du initiierst und leitest eigenständig cross-funktionale Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung und treibst den gezielten Einsatz von KI-Tools voran, um repetitive Aufgaben zu automatisieren und Kapazitäten für das Wesentliche freizusetzen: unsere Kund:innen und ihre Patient:innen.
  • Du nutzt operative Daten und Kundenfeedback, um Verbesserungen in Produkt und Prozess voranzutreiben – z. B. in Feedback Loops mit Tech und Product.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Onboarding oder Technical Support mit komplexen Systemen – idealerweise mit Telefonanlagen oder vergleichbarer Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur
  • Erfahrung in der direkten Kundenbetreuung sowie im Stakeholder Management mit externen Ansprechpartner:innen und internen Teams
  • Eigenständige Lernbereitschaft und nachweislicher Impact bei Prozess- und Projektverantwortung
  • Erfahrung im aktiven Einsatz von KI-Tools und in der Förderung ihrer sinnvollen Nutzung im Team
  • Fließendes Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mind. B2)

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

ad58721a3b67.title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
ad58721a3b67.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike. Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible. Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use. 7cd6894bfaf4.description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.
  • Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.
  • Data Pipelines & Integration: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.
  • Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.
  • Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.
  • Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

You will thrive in this role if

  • Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills: You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.
  • Experience with dbt: You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.
  • Data Engineering & Python: You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.
  • Data Warehousing Knowledge: You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

f6eb439fa04f.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Security Engineering team's mission is to safeguard our AI systems and maintain the trust of our users and society at large. Whether we're developing critical security infrastructure, building secure development practices, or partnering with our research and product teams, we are committed to operating as a world-class security organization and keeping the safety and trust of our users at the forefront of everything we do.

Responsibilities:

  • Build security for large-scale AI clusters across multiple clouds and bare-metal data centers, including IAM, network segmentation and encryption controls
  • Design and implement network security controls: default-deny ingress and egress, segmentation between research, training and production environments, private connectivity across clouds and data centers, cloud firewall policy and mTLS with service identity
  • Ship these controls as secure defaults using infrastructure as code and GitOps workflows, so new clusters, VPCs and data center links inherit the right boundaries
  • Build visibility into network traffic and boundary drift, with detection for exfiltration paths and automated remediation where it is safe to do so
  • Design secure-by-design development workflows and CI/CD pipelines across our services, with expertise in Kubernetes security, container orchestration and identity management
  • Threat model and assess risk for complex multi cloud and networked environments, and join infrastructure networking, cluster and data center teams at design time so topology, routing and firewall decisions carry our security requirements from day one
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to hiring and growth of the Security team

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8-15+ years of software engineering experience implementing and maintaining critical systems at scale
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python or at least one systems language (Go, Rust, C/C++)
  • Experience implementing and operating critical systems at scale using DevOps and cloud automation practices such as infrastructure as code
  • Hands-on network security engineering in cloud or on-prem environments, for example VPC design, cloud firewall policy, egress control, private service connectivity or network segmentation
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes security and networking, including network policy, service identity and container hardening
  • Experience with threat modeling and risk assessment for networked and multi cloud systems
  • Track record of driving engineering excellence through high standards, constructive code reviews and mentorship
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical concepts across organizational levels and bring clarity and ownership to ambiguous technical problems
  • Low ego, high empathy engineer who attracts talent and supports diverse, inclusive teams
  • Experience supporting fast-paced startup engineering teams

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Secured Kubernetes networking at scale (CNI, network policy, service mesh or mTLS rollouts) or worked in high-assurance environments where controls had to be evidenced, not just deployed
  • Worked on interconnects and private connectivity between cloud providers and physical data centers, including management-plane and out-of-band network security
  • Built network traffic visibility or exfiltration detection systems
  • Exposure to large-scale distributed training and what it demands of a network
  • Led cross-functional security initiatives and navigated complex organizational dynamics
  • Managing infrastructure through automated configuration and policy enforcement
  • Hardening containerized applications and enforcing security policies

ed7fb9afd151.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking Software Engineers to join our Observability team within the Infrastructure organization. The Observability team owns the monitoring and telemetry infrastructure that every engineer and researcher at Anthropic depends on—from metrics and logging pipelines to distributed tracing, profiling, error analytics, alerting, and the dashboards and query interfaces that make it all actionable. By joining this team, you'll have a direct impact on the reliability and operational excellence of Anthropic's research and product systems.

As Anthropic scales its infrastructure across massive GPU, TPU, and Trainium clusters, the volume and complexity of operational data is growing by orders of magnitude—and an increasing share of the hardest problems live below the application layer. We're building next-generation observability systems—high-throughput telemetry pipelines, fleet-wide continuous profiling, eBPF-based tracing and network visibility, and agentic diagnostic tools—so engineers can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues in minutes rather than hours, even when the answer lies in the kernel, the network stack, or an accelerator rather than on a dashboard.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable telemetry ingest and storage pipelines for metrics, logs, traces, and error data across Anthropic's multi-cluster infrastructure
  • Build observability solutions that give engineers deep, low-overhead visibility into system behavior across the fleet
  • Own and evolve core observability platforms, driving migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth
  • Build instrumentation libraries, SDKs, and eBPF-based auto-instrumentation to emit high-quality telemetry, with and without code changes
  • Reduce mean time to detection and resolution by building cross-signal correlation—from kernel-level events up to application traces—unified query interfaces, and AI-assisted diagnostic tooling
  • Drive fleet-wide efficiency by turning continuous profiling and utilization telemetry into actionable optimization insights across CPU, memory, and accelerator fleets
  • Partner with Research, Inference, Product, and Infrastructure teams to ensure observability solutions meet the unique needs of each organization

Minimum qualifications

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating large-scale observability or monitoring infrastructure
  • Have deep, hands-on experience with observability signals end to end—from instrumentation through ingest to query and analysis
  • Understand high-throughput telemetry pipelines and the tradeoffs involved in collecting, storing, and querying operational data at scale
  • Are comfortable digging below the application layer into the kernel, the network stack, or the hardware
  • Have excellent communication skills and enjoy partnering with internal teams to improve their operational visibility and incident response capabilities
  • Are excited about building foundational infrastructure and comfortable navigating ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges, both independently and with a team

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including building and operating large-scale observability or monitoring infrastructure
  • Experience building or operating eBPF-based observability in production—tracing, profiling, or network visibility
  • Experience running continuous profiling at fleet scale, including managing overhead budgets and symbolization
  • Kernel- and syscall-level debugging experience and performance engineering craft
  • Experience profiling or instrumenting accelerator workloads
  • Experience operating metrics systems at very high cardinality, or large-scale telemetry storage backends
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collector pipelines, and tail-based sampling strategies
  • Interest in applying AI/LLMs to operational workflows such as automated root cause analysis, anomaly detection, or intelligent alerting

Introduction: 

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology. 

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Autoplanner team, you will own the software engineering that brings our data science and machine learning products into live production. Autoplanner builds AI-powered systems that unify planning across global warehouses and last-mile assets, delivering globally optimized plans that maximize profit and minimize lateness. You will act as the engineering partner to our data scientists, ensuring our systems remain robust, highly scalable, and efficient as we roll out to more international retail partners. Our services are mostly Python, but we use Java where a service integrates closely with the Ocado Smart Platform, to take advantage of its shared tooling.

In this role, you will write typed, well-tested Python and oversee cloud-based data applications from end to end. You will contribute to core architectural decisions, improve CI/CD pipelines, and raise engineering standards across the team through pairing, code reviews, and shared tooling. Additionally, you will harness AI coding tools in production while maintaining a strong emphasis on engineering discipline, system performance, and high-quality software craft.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain data- and ML-driven, cloud-based applications.
  • Build and maintain robust APIs and data contracts for data science teams and broader Ocado systems.
  • Manage cloud deployments and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines across diverse AWS environments.
  • Package, version, serve, and monitor machine learning models in live production environments.
  • Drive architecture decisions across repository, application, and system levels, documenting them as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Partner directly with data scientists to transition advanced algorithms and models into scalable production systems.
  • Collaborate with software engineers across Ocado Technology to integrate applications within the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP).
  • Elevate engineering practices across the team through pairing, code reviews, shared tooling, and responsible AI agent integration.
  • Share in on-call and production support responsibilities for critical live operational services.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Software Engineer owning end-to-end production Python services.
  • Extensive background building data-intensive cloud applications, preferably asynchronous, event-driven, or queue-based architectures.
  • Strong practical knowledge of AWS and/or GCP identity, networking, and messaging services.
  • Solid software design capabilities, including defining system boundaries and crafting high-level architectures.
  • Rigorous testing and delivery discipline, encompassing integration testing and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Hands-on MLOps experience, specifically in packaging, serving, and monitoring ML models in production.
  • Demonstrated track record of collaborating effectively with data scientists and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Practical experience using AI coding agents on production codebases, with a sharp judgment on validating and verifying AI-generated output.

Benefits:

  • Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

42ff1fee78ff.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown
42ff1fee78ff.description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available. Team For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become. You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding. You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you. This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game. You will be central to that transition. Role You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that. Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will: Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server. Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted. Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities. The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang). To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions. Profile 5+ years of backend development experience Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment) Mastery of SQL and NoSQL Background in high-scale systems Understanding of Unix-like environments AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work Experience working in cross-functional agile teams Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders. Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously. A deep interest in game development is a plus. Based or willing to relocate in Paris Benefits Best-in-class compensation Other benefits according to the country you reside Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
