7413c66ddcf5.title: AI Unity Tools Engineer
7413c66ddcf5.description: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years. This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles. What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment. The opportunity As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio. You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made. What you'll do Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games. Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable. Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality. Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling. Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used. Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations. Requirements Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke. Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it. Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions. Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain a complex technical solution to developers, QA teams, and studios in a few sentences. AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of. Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this role as a chance to build something new and grow faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it. Bonus: you've built something. An internal tool, a testing framework, a game, a side project. We'd love to hear about it. For this role, you'll also bring Hands-on experience with Unity and the ability to understand Unity games, game systems, and testing contexts. Proven experience using AI systems, models, or AI-enabled engineering workflows in practice. Strong DevOps understanding, including TeamCity, build pipelines, and infrastructure. The ability to work across technical topics while understanding the wider product and business context. Experience working in a complex environment with meaningful product and testing volumes. Bonus points if you have: Experience building QA automation or testing frameworks. Experience with AI-driven exploratory testing. Experience in gaming or another Unity-based product environment. Experience supporting products with high testing volumes. Experience driving adoption of internal tools across multiple teams. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Why Homa Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Real ownership, early. This is a new initiative. Your tools will change how Homa and its studios build and test games, and you'll see the results. A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow. AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works. Benefits Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect: 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more. 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces. 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout

fe44b0f57f87.title: Senior Optical Systems Engineer
fe44b0f57f87.description: About Quandela: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions About this position: You will join the QPU Prototyping team , which develops and integrates the optical systems at the heart of Quandela's quantum processors, turning advanced R&D experiments into operational hardware. We are looking for a Senior Optical Systems Engineer to take ownership of a major optical development work package within our next-generation QPU programme. Your main challenge will be to maximise optical transmission and system performance , from experimental characterisation and precision alignment to qualification and integration. You'll tackle complex optical challenges, defining the right experimental approaches and driving solutions from investigation to validation. You will also coordinate technical activities involving several engineers and scientists, ensuring the delivery of critical milestones. This is a predominantly hands-on experimental role , combining deep technical expertise with project ownership. Requirements What you'll do: Develop and optimise optical systems Design, assemble, align and operate complex optical setups. Characterise optical transmission, identify losses and improve efficiency. Define measurement methods and improve stability and reproducibility. Troubleshoot experimental challenges and implement reliable solutions. Qualify and integrate optical subsystems Optimise research-developed optical subsystems for QPU integration. Define experimental tests, performance targets and qualification procedures. Collaborate with optics, electronics and system integration teams. Drive technical delivery Own technical deliverables within a major optical development project. Coordinate experimental activities across engineers and scientists. Plan tasks, milestones, equipment and laboratory resources. Anticipate technical risks, resolve blockers and guide contributors. The role combines approximately 80% hands-on experimental work and 20% technical coordination , with no initial requirement for formal people management. - How you'll grow: First 3 months: Become familiar with Quandela's optical systems, experimental infrastructure and qualification objectives. Within 6 months: Take ownership of optical characterisation and optimisation activities, coordinating experimental work and technical milestones. Within 12 months: Lead the technical delivery of complex optical developments, with increasing autonomy over planning and resources. Longer term : Potential progression towards technical team leadership as the team grows. - Requirements What we're looking for: We are looking for an experienced optical engineer or experimental scientist with strong hands-on expertise and the ability to drive complex technical projects. Relevant backgrounds include fibered optical systems, laser systems, experimental optics, and optical metrology. Academic and industrial experience are equally welcome. Must-have: PhD in Optics, Photonics, Physics or related fields. >5 years of experimental experience , including postdoctoral research. Hands-on expertise in complex optical systems, alignment and troubleshooting. Strong knowledge of linear optics, optical transmission and precision metrology. Proven ability to optimise optical performance and solve experimental challenges. Experience organising technical work and delivering project milestones. Experimental rigour, teamwork and professional English. French is not required. Important, but you can grow here: Technical & system integration Optical subsystem qualification and hardware integration. Python for experimental automation and data analysis. Semiconductor optics and quantum optical systems. Project & operational ownership Experimental planning, equipment and resource management. Coordination of multidisciplinary technical activities. Bonus: Experience transferring R&D setups into operational systems. Industrial qualification and reliability standards. Experience mentoring engineers or researchers. Exposure to quantum computing or advanced photonic hardware. Quantum computing experience is not required . What matters is your ability to understand complex optical systems, solve experimental challenges and deliver results. Benefits Benefits Join a multidisciplinary team developing the optical systems for next-generation quantum processors, with substantial experimental ownership and opportunities for technical progression. Competitive compensation aligned with experience. Company savings plan and profit-sharing. 100% health coverage through Alan. Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. Swile meal vouchers. Gymlib and childcare support. Referral programme. Process Talent Acquisition interview (30–45 min) Hiring Manager interview (45–60 min) Technical discussion on previous experimental work Technical case study or presentation with the team Reference checks Team meeting Offer Beyond that: At Quandela, we value diverse scientific and engineering backgrounds, practical curiosity and the ability to learn from different fields. Whether your experience comes from an academic laboratory, industrial R&D or a different area of experimental optics, we'd love to hear from you if you enjoy

6f2db088f279.description:
What we do

Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

We are looking for a Software Engineer FullStack to join the DOPE (Doctor Practice Evolution) team in the Clinical domain.

As a Software Engineer, you will help doctors create and deliver all types of prescriptions, covering the full lifecycle from drug prescription creation and renewal to medication search and paramedical care, across France and Germany. Team is also responsible for the creation of more than 2M prescriptions per week. 

You will work within a regulatory-heavy environment, collaborate with external drug database providers, and contribute to medication alert features based on patient profiles.

What you'll build

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to build features that deliver value to healthcare professionals and patients

  • Design and implement technical solutions ensuring performance, security, and usability across our fullstack applications (React, TypeScript, JVM ecosystem)

  • Contribute to code quality through reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of our development practices

  • Share your expertise and collaborate across teams to evolve Doctolib's architecture and technical standards

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What you'll bring

Before you read on — if you don't meet the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply!

  • You have fullstack software engineering experience with React/Typescript and the JVM ecosystem (Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot) - Ruby experience is a bonus
  • You have a "user first" mindset and are committed to building secure, well-tested, and pragmatic code
  • You bring a strong testing culture and are passionate about code quality
  • You are proactive, curious, and eager to share knowledge through pair programming and collaboration

 What we offer

  • Free health insurance for you and your children
  • Parent Care Program: receive one additional month of leave on top of the legal parental leave
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Work Council subsidy to refund part of sport club membership or creative class
  • Up to 14 days of RTT
  • A subsidy to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class 
  • Lunch voucher with Swile card
  • Reimbursement of public transportation 
  • Relocation support for international mobilities
  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Standard interview process 

  • Recruiter Interview
  • Coding Interview
  • System Design Interview
  • Behavioral Interview
  • Reference check
  • Offer!

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Full Time
  • Based in Levallois-Perret
  • Hybrid position
  • Start date: As soon as possible

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

405f45c8506d.title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
405f45c8506d.description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).
  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.
  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.
  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.
  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality
  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.
  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)
  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach
  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 
  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR
  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch
  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling
  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring
  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)
  • Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference
  • Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts
  • Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers)
  • Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.
  • We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practi

7e88c4715133.title: Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F
7e88c4715133.description:
Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

 

Nous recherchons un(e) Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture pour piloter et développer notre expertise en software engineering, tout en accompagnant nos clients dans leurs transformations les plus complexes.

Ce rôle de leadership technologique, s'articule autour de trois dimensions essentielles : Engineering Leadership, Architecture & Transformation et Client Development.

En tant que Software Engineering Chapter Lead, vous définirez les orientations techniques, renforcerez les standards d'ingénierie et accompagnerez le développement de notre communauté de Tech Leads, d'architectes et d'ingénieurs seniors.

Vous aurez une forte proximité avec les technologies et la réalisation des projets, tout en collaborant avec les décideurs de haut niveau chez nos clients afin de structurer leurs transformations, d'influencer leurs choix technologiques et de développer de nouvelles opportunités pour Capco.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Engineering & Chapter Leadership

  • Piloter et développer notre communauté software engineering en définissant les standards, les principes et les bonnes pratiques.
  • Accompagner, coacher et faire monter en compétences les tech leads, les architectes et les ingénieurs seniors, tout en contribuant au développement des expertises.
  • Promouvoir une culture d'excellence en ingénierie, de responsabilisation technique et d'amélioration continue.

Hands-on Architecture & Engineering

1353735e340f.title: Lead Software Engineer
1353735e340f.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points: About you: A short description of yourself. Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences. Startup: Why do you fit a startup? Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

b38f2e24b5d6.title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist

We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Your portfolio includes: Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones. Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. 2a7321ec92fd.title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
2a7321ec92fd.description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.
  • Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.
  • Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.
  • Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.
  • Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.
  • Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.
  • Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.
  • Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.
  • Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.
  • Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.
  • Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

2a4a9d75b4d1.title: Technisch Support Engineer
2a4a9d75b4d1.description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren? Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken. Je ondersteunt klanten telefonisch en per mail bij technische vragen en problemen. Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen. Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren. Je schakelt servicemonteurs in wanneer een probleem niet op afstand kan worden opgelost en zorgt voor een goede overdracht. Je helpt onze support steeds slimmer en beter te maken Je herkent terugkerende problemen en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen. Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies. Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren. Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken. Wat we belangrijk vinden: Je hebt een technische hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt technisch en analytisch inzicht en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen werken. Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig, ook met mensen die minder technische kennis hebben. Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands. Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan. Je vindt het leuk om zowel met techniek als met mensen bezig te zijn. Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar. Mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste: Ervaring met technische support, troubleshooting of klantcontact. Kennis van warmtepompen, installatietechniek of andere technische systemen. Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €3.000 tot €4.000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 27 vakantiedagen. Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. De mogelijkheid om mee te delen in het succes van DeWarmte via onze Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR). Veel ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en collega's die graag samenwerken. De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, naast onze gezamenlijke kantoordagen. En natuurlijk de kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie met producten die we zelf ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Zin om mee te bouwen? Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je. Compensation: €3K – €4K per month • €3K – €4K per month Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

30e22ab1d7df.title: Senior Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
30e22ab1d7df.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.

You will leverage your expertise in machine learning to research, design and implement new models for report and appeals prioritization, advanced sanctioning based on users' suspicions, and automation of moderation decisions. This involves working closely with our engineering teams to develop robust pipelines for data handling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will utilize advanced machine learning techniques to analyze text, images, and other data formats, tackling complex challenges to identify and address content that poses potential risks. You will champion best practices and methodologies, significantly enhancing the team's effectiveness and safeguarding Vinted. You will mentor others, influence the strategic direction for model development, and facilitate cross-functional collaborations to drive impactful results.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the research, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of production machine learning models that prioritize and automate actions on harmful marketplace entities at scale.
  • Play a crucial role in establishing and refining essential machine learning processes, such as data versioning, creating labeling pipelines, and ensuring high-quality data availability for effective model training.
  • Actively collaborate across teams, particularly with Data Infrastructure and backend engineers, to develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of deployed models.
  • Influence and contribute to the strategic roadmap for the Actioning team, collaborating with Decision Scientists to test, assess, and continuously improve new models.

About you 

  • Proven track record in data science (4+ years of experience), with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, or computational mathematics.
  • Proficiency in both classical and deep learning techniques, and an adeptness in leveraging the latest tools and methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI applications or LLM-powered workflows that handle large traffic, balancing quality, latency, and cost efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of the challenges involved in deploying, maintaining, and scaling real-time ML models in production, with a proven ability to address these challenges effectively.
  • Proven capability to work with engineering teams, designing and implementing efficient data ingestion, feature engineering, and model training pipelines that support robust and reliable model deployment.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning and data science, driving innovation and thought leadership within the team.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring that technical elements are properly understood and integrated to deliver business value.
  • Past experience with fraud detection, harmful content detection or any other adversarial domain would be considered an advantage. 

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefi

7113f6a0ebb1.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
7113f6a0ebb1.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
  • AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.
  • Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
  • Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
  • Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
  • Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
  • Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
  • Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)

  • Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
  • Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic

7c50d39d9f64.title: Agentic AI Principal
7c50d39d9f64.description:
We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.

Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.

The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.

Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning

  • Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.
  • Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.
  • Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.
  • Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.
  • Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building

  • Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.
  • Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.
  • Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.
  • Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.
  • Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.
  • Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.
  • Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards

  • Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.
  • Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.
  • Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.
  • Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

  • Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.
  • Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.
  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and genera

b10c5c6b9fc2.title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
b10c5c6b9fc2.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it. A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance. A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance. Collective insurance plans. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best. Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization. WANT TO KNOW MORE? We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265. A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
